description: Finds addresses in the address registry of Georgia, with the municipality and the centre point of each. Write the street and the number in Georgian (ჭავჭავაძის გამზირი 44) and give the municipality (თბილისი): the order of NAPR is poor, and other cities often come first. Pass a centre point to parcels_list_nearby_parcels to find the parcel. Data from NAPR.

limit.description: The maximum count of addresses, 1 to 20. The default is 5.

municipality.description: Only addresses whose municipality holds this text, in Georgian: თბილისი.

query.description: The street and the number, in Georgian or Latin letters.

name: parcels_search_addresses

addresses.description: The addresses, in the order of NAPR.

centre.description: The centre point of the address.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the addresses, RFC 3339.

source.description: The source of the data: NAPR.

stale.description: Always false: an address search is never stale.

title: Search the addresses of Georgia
